## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation that motivates this feature request. What use case is currently unsupported or awkward?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you would like to see. Be specific about the expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches you have considered and why they are insufficient.

## Service

Which service(s) would this affect?

- [ ] selar-console (frontend)
- [ ] selar-api (Go backend)
- [ ] selar-worker (Python ingestion)
- [ ] Database / schema
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, or related issues that provide context.
